reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS DATE) AS order_month,
       COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE channel = 'web'
GROUP BY 1
alternatives: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS DATE) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)))

SELECT make_date(year(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))), month(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))), 1) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT make_date(year(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))), month(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))), 1) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: Building the date from the Amsterdam year and month works, but it converts the time twice where date_trunc needs it once.

planted_wrong.sql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', order_ts) AS DATE) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' GROUP BY 1
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', order_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS DATE) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' GROUP BY 1

solver.query:
SELECT date_trunc('month', (order_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')::DATE AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE channel = 'web'
GROUP BY 1
